newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to confirm B Band qualifiers by June 27.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to confirm B Band qualifiers by June 27.

text.p: Brazilian Communications Minister Sergio Motta said he hopes to announce the final list of qualified bidders for the sale of Band B cellular services by June 27.
Motta told reporters the ministry has received 26 administrative appeals, including five from disqualified groups and the rest from approved bidders questioning the qualification of other consortia.

The Communications Ministry announced a preliminary list of qualifiers early this month. Ten out of the 15 consortia which presented bids in early April were declared eligible to compete for the Band B concessions.
According to the tender rules, bidders which are the object of appeals have until Friday to respond and a special committee overseeing the selloff has another week to announce its decision.
Motta said bidding rules allow him a further five days to confirm the final list but he hopes he will not have to use the extra time.
He also noted groups who are still unhappy with the ministry's final decision may decide to appeal in court.
